text: Coffee with Zainab. She's finally moving to Leeds, keys on 2 November 2026. Her mum is coming down to help pack. Need to ask her for the new address before then.

Long catch-up with Leon on the phone. He and Fiona are flying to Tokyo on the 12th at half 9 in the morning, 14 hours direct. He hates long flights, already dreading it. Fiona's sorted all the itinerary. Text him a good luck message the night before. Their cat Miso is going to Fiona's mum while they're away. They're back on the 26th, landing Sunday at 6pm, and Fiona wants a dinner that week to show everyone photos.
Victor rang. Viewing a flat in Bristol Saturday at 11am, second one this month. His brother Mateo might move in with him if it works out. Mateo's a nurse, nights mostly.

Lunch w Laila. Her dad has his hip op on Thursday morning. She's flying back to Lahore straight after to look after him, probably three weeks. She sounded really worn out. Must check in with her next week. Her husband Joe is staying here with the kids, Alfie and Phoebe, and her brother Idris is flying out from Dubai to share the hospital visits. She's got work to sort too, her boss has been decent about it.
Dorota's sister Katarzyna is getting married in Kraków in March 2027! Whole family's going. Dorota's doing a reading and is terrified about it.
Asha's lot are off to Portugal Friday at 6am. Kids are 4 and 7 so she's bracing herself for the airport.
Hassan says the move to Glasgow fell through, buyer pulled out. They're staying put for now. He's gutted but kind of relieved too, his partner Afua never wanted to leave London.
Note to self: passport expires January 2027, renew before booking anything.

Met Alejandro for a drink after work. He's just back from three weeks in Mexico seeing his grandmother, who turned 90. Showed me loads of photos. His girlfriend Vanessa came along for the second week. He's back at work Monday.
Don't forget to ask Joe how the viewing went on Tuesday evening. The one with the garden.
Lars and his wife are celebrating 25 years on 14 December 2026, going to Iceland to see the northern lights. He mentioned she'd love a decent camera. Maybe go in with Nia on something?
Nia called. Her son Dawit starts uni in Edinburgh next September, she's already anxious about him being so far away. Also her boiler broke again lol.

Fang's mum is visiting from Chengdu for six weeks from the 3rd. First time she's been over since Fang moved here. Fang's planning a trip to the Lakes with her on the weekend of the 18th. Her mum's never been to the UK in winter so Fang's bought her a massive coat. Her brother Lars might fly over for the last week if he can get leave. Fang says her mum wants to see Edinburgh too.
Ricardo cancelled the Lisbon trip, work won't give him the time off. Says he'll try for spring instead.

Alfie told me his partner Anika's pregnant, due in May 2027! They're also house hunting, want somewhere with a second bedroom before the baby arrives. Viewing two places Sunday afternoon in Walthamstow. Send them a congrats card.

Zara's flight lands Wednesday at 7:40pm, I'm picking her up from Heathrow. She's been away two years in Singapore so it's a big deal. Her sister Anika is doing a welcome back dinner at hers on Saturday at 7:30pm and I said I'd bring wine.
Jamal's moving to Berlin for work, last day at the office is Friday 31st. Leaving drinks the same night at the Crown from 6.
Phoebe's dog Biscuit had surgery on his leg yesterday, she's been up all night with him. Text her tomorrow morning to see how he is.

Caught up with Adaeze. She's in Lagos till the 9th for her cousin's wedding, then Accra for a week. Her husband Emeka stayed home with the twins. She said the wedding had 600 guests. Back at work on the 20th.

Idris and Katarzyna are finally moving in together. Flat in Manchester, they get the keys tomorrow at noon. Idris is stressing about the van because the parking is a nightmare. I said I'd help carry stuff Saturday morning. Katarzyna's parents are driving over from Poland to help paint the following week, which Idris is quietly dreading. They're both working from home on Monday to unpack.
Andre's mum is moving into a care home next month. He's finding it really hard, they had to sell the family house. Must ring him this weekend.
Antoine is flying to Montreal on Sunday at 10pm for his dad's 70th. Surprise party, so don't mention it on the group chat.

Bumped into Santiago at the station. He's training for the Valencia marathon on 6 December 2026, running five days a week. Lives in Hackney now with his girlfriend. He's raising money for a mental health charity because of his brother Andre. Wants to beat 3 hours 30.
Book the flights to Athens before the price goes up. Thinking 2 to 9 June 2027.
Victor's moving date is now 15 November, Saturday at 8am the van comes. Remind me to send him the number for my mate with the removal company.
Fiona said Leon got food poisoning on the last night in Tokyo and the flight home was miserable. He's better now. Check how he's feeling at football Thursday.
Zainab's brother Hassan is looking at flats near her in Leeds too. Their mum would love having both of them in one city. She's coeliac by the way, keep in mind if I host.
Asha said the Portugal trip was amazing, kids loved the beach. Her husband got sunburnt on day one. They're already talking about going back next summer.
Mrs Haddad next door told me her grandson is moving in with her while he looks for work. Nice lad, his name's Jamal too.
Phoebe says Biscuit is home and doing ok, wearing the cone of shame. She's taking him back to the vet on Friday at 4.
Need to call Mateo about the spare room. He said he'd decide by the end of the week, Friday at the latest.

Talked to Laila. Dad's op went well and he's walking with a frame already. She's staying in Lahore until 28 November 2026 then flying back. Her husband Joe has been holding the fort with the kids. Send her something nice when she's back.
Dorota's nervous about the reading at Katarzyna's wedding, she's practising every night. Wedding's Saturday 13 March 2027 at 2pm. Get Dorota a good luck card nearer the time.

Hassan and Afua are off to Morocco for Christmas, flying the 22nd at 7am. Afua's family are in Marrakech. Hassan's never met her grandma before so a bit nervous. Afua says her grandma is the real boss of the family. They're back on 2 January 2027 at 10pm.
Alejandro mentioned his sister Laila got into Oxford for a master's, starts January 2027. He's so proud. Should send her a congrats message.
Just had the call from the estate agent. Viewing the flat on Elm Road tomorrow at 5:30pm, second viewing Thursday morning if I like it.
Joe says the garden flat's a no, damp everywhere. He's seeing two more on the 7th, one at 10 and one at half 12. Still hoping to move before Christmas. His girlfriend Zara is very keen on Clapham.
Lars said the Iceland trip is booked, 12 to 16 December 2026. His wife doesn't know it's for their anniversary yet. Big surprise. He wants to propose again, renew the vows on a glacier apparently.
Nia's daughter Afua has her driving test Monday at 9.15. Nia says she's a nervous wreck about it. Text Afua good luck Sunday night.
Pick up a travel adapter and the euros before Friday.
Fang had to cut the Lakes trip short, her mum fell and twisted her ankle. Spent Sunday night in A&E. Mum's ok but on crutches now and they flew back to Chengdu early. Call Fang tomorrow evening.
Ricardo's dad Lars is retiring after 40 years on the trains. Last shift is 30 October, party at their house the Saturday after at 7pm. Ricardo asked me to bring a dessert.
Alfie and Anika put an offer in on the Walthamstow place! Two bed, small garden. Should hear back Monday. If it goes through they'd move around February 2027.
Zara said her flight from Singapore was 13 hours and she didn't sleep at all. She's jetlagged and starting the new job Monday morning. Text her Monday evening to ask how the first day went.
Jamal's leaving drinks were a laugh. He flies to Berlin Sunday at 6:50am. His mum cried apparently. Got to send him the photos.

Long call with Adaeze tonight. Emeka's mum has moved in with them for a few months to help with the twins, who are 18 months now and into everything. Adaeze says it's a lot but she's grateful. Her own mum is in Lagos and not well, so Adaeze is planning to fly out again in February 2027, maybe for a month. Emeka might take the twins over at Easter so the grandparents can see them. She's also thinking about going back to work part time in the spring. Ask her about February closer to the time.
Idris said the move went fine apart from the sofa not fitting through the door. Katarzyna's furious. They're having a housewarming on 21 November 2026 from 8pm.
Andre called back. His mum has settled in better than expected at the care home. He visits every Sunday afternoon. Still sad about the house sale.
Antoine says the surprise for his dad worked, he cried. Antoine's staying in Montreal till Wednesday, back at 6am Thursday.
Santiago's knee is playing up, had to skip his long run on Sunday. Physio appointment tomorrow at 8am. He's worried he'll miss the marathon.
Victor and Mateo are definitely moving in together. Bristol flat, two bed, near the harbour. Mateo has a cat called Pepper who's coming too. Victor's allergic which should be fun.
Mum and I agreed Christmas at hers this year, I'm driving down on the 23rd.
Dawit's mum Nia said he's already looking at flats in Edinburgh for next year, which she thinks is way too early. He wants to study medicine. Big rugby fan too.

Vanessa told me she and Alejandro are thinking about moving to Valencia in 2027. She can work remotely and he's been learning Spanish on Duolingo every day. Nothing decided. Her dad lives there already and has offered them his spare flat for the first few months. Alejandro's mum less keen.
Remind me to ask Zainab how the first week in Leeds has been. Moved in on the 2nd, so check in this weekend.
Dorota has a dog called Max who goes to her parents whenever she travels. She's off to Kraków again on 5 January 2027 for her sister's dress fitting.
Phoebe's partner Ricardo is getting nervous about his first marathon. Phoebe says he's been checking the weather in Seville obsessively. Race is 22 February 2027 at 8:30am.
Andre's daughter Zara has her first nativity play on 10 December at 2pm. She's a sheep. He's hoping to film it.
Laila's back. She said she'd love one of those neck pillows for the next long flight, the old one fell apart. Christmas idea.
Catching up with Leon, Fiona and their little one Nia on Sunday at 3pm, meeting at the park.
